issue.title: graph-rag latency: sequential triples-query round trips
issue.body: tg-invoke-graph-rag is slow on wide traversals. graph_rag.Processor issues one triples-query call per hop over Pulsar, and each call round-trips to Memgraph. Latency grows linearly with hop count.

comment.body: Profiling says the hop count is not the real cost, the messaging is. A direct Bolt traversal against Memgraph would collapse the per-hop calls into one query and remove the Pulsar hop entirely.

note: New discussion reveals an alternative approach; #922 gains inferred concepts.
